body.label: Trigger
body.html: An enemy within weapon range deals damage to you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Reduce the triggering damage by 1, minimum 0. You may spend 1 Combo to make a Basic Strike against the attacker after the Action resolves.

surges.html: One adjacent ally also gains +1 Defense against the triggering effect.
After this Reaction resolves, move 1 unit without triggering Reactions from the triggering creature.
